# komodo_onboarding_key (Resource)

Manages a Komodo server onboarding key. Periphery presents the matching private key on first contact and Komodo Core registers a Server using this key's settings. The private_key value is only available at creation time.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "komodo_onboarding_key" "fleet" {
  name           = "fleet-bootstrap"
  enabled        = true
  expires        = 0    # 0 = no expiry; otherwise unix-millis
  privileged     = false
  create_builder = true # also provision a Builder for each onboarded server
}

# `private_key` is only returned at create time — capture it now.
output "fleet_private_key" {
  value     = komodo_onboarding_key.fleet.private_key
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name for the onboarding key.

### Optional

- `copy_server` (String) Server (ID or name) whose config to duplicate onto servers onboarded with this key.
- `create_builder` (Boolean) Whether to provision a Builder alongside each onboarded server.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the key can be used. Disable to revoke without deleting.
- `expires` (Number) Unix timestamp in milliseconds when the key expires. 0 = never.
- `privileged` (Boolean) Allow this key to enable disabled servers, remove address config, and update existing server public keys.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags applied by default to servers onboarded with this key.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier (the public_key, which mutations key off).
- `private_key` (String, Sensitive) PKCS8 private key. Returned only at creation time and cannot be recovered later. Sensitive.
- `public_key` (String) SPKI base64 public key. Stable identifier used for Update / Delete.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an existing onboarding key by its public_key value (the canonical id).
# The PKCS8 private_key cannot be recovered after import — only at create time.
terraform import komodo_onboarding_key.fleet "MCowBQYDK2VuAyEA0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz="
```
